MagKick 10 – 10000 mAh Mini Magnetic Power Bank with Wireless Charger & Kickstand

MagKick 10 power bank is the next-generation mini magnetic  designed to keep your devices charged anytime, anywhere. With a powerful 10,000 mAh capacity, 15W wireless charging, and 22.5W fast wired output, it’s the ultimate compact companion for smartphones, tablets, and gadgets on the go. The built-in magnetic kickstand lets you charge while watching videos hands-free—making it perfect for work, travel, or leisure.

Power Meets Portability

The MagKick 10 magnetic power bank redefines portable charging with a sleek, lightweight design that fits perfectly in your pocket. Compatible with Mag Safe-enabled iPhones and other wireless charging devices, this compact charger delivers stable, secure, and efficient power transfer without messy cables. The integrated wireless charging coil ensures a reliable 15W output, while the dual USB-A and USB-C ports allow for simultaneous charging of multiple devices.

Fast, Smart & Efficient Charging

Engineered with Qualcomm 3.0 + PD (Power Delivery) technology, the MagKick 10 guarantees faster, smarter charging. It adjusts power delivery according to your device’s needs, ensuring optimal battery health. Whether you’re powering up an Android smartphone, iPhone, or tablet, enjoy 22.5W fast charging that saves time and keeps you powered up all day. The LED battery indicators show real-time charge status, so you always know when to recharge.

Compact Design with Kickstand Convenience

The unique magnetic kickstand lets you prop your phone for hands-free viewing while charging wirelessly. Its sturdy yet flexible design makes it ideal for travel, video calls, or entertainment. Crafted with durable, premium materials, this mini power bank combines style and performance effortlessly. Available in modern matte finishes, it complements your tech lifestyle perfectly.

Key Features of MagKick 10 Power Bank

  • Battery Capacity: 10,000 mAh – enough to fully charge most smartphones 2-3 times
  • Wireless Charging: 15W fast magnetic wireless charger for Mag Safe devices
  • Output Ports: 1 USB-A + 1 USB-C supporting 22.5W fast charging
  • Charging Protocols: Qualcomm 3.0 + PD (Power Delivery) supported
  • Kickstand: Built-in magnetic kickstand for comfortable viewing while charging
  • Compact & Lightweight: Slim pocket design for easy portability
  • Safety: Overcharge, overheat, and short-circuit protection

Why Choose MagKick 10?

When it comes to fast charging power banks, MagKick 10 stands out with its unique combination of wireless convenience, dual output ports, and smart charging compatibility. Whether you’re a traveler, a busy professional, or a gadget lover, this wireless magnetic power bank ensures your devices stay powered up wherever you go.
